steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Completing the square: x^2 + bx = (x + b/2)^2 - (b/2)^2

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Solve 2x^2 - 5x - 3 = 0 and hence solve 2sin^2θ - 5sinθ - 3 = 0 for 0 <= θ < 2pi --- Solution: 2x^2 - 5x - 3 = (2x+1)(x-3) = 0 -> x = -½ or x = 3. Since sinθ ∈ [-1,1], sinθ = -½ -> θ = 7pi/6, 11pi/6

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Solve 3x^2 + 10x - 8 = 0 by factorising | Solve x^2 - 6x + 2 = 0 by completing the square | Use the quadratic formula for 5x^2 - 3x - 1 = 0, leave in surd form

steps.title: Lesson plan
steps.body: Starter (5 min): Recall prior knowledge of quadratic equations with quick questions. Teaching (15 min): Work through each of the learning objectives, explaining principles step by step. Key points review (5 min): Revisit the key points together, confirming understanding. Worked example (10 min): Model the example question: Solve 2x^2 - 5x - 3 = 0 and hence solve 2sin^2θ - 5sinθ - 3 = 0 for 0 <= θ < 2pi. Solution: 2x^2 - 5x - 3 = (2x+1)(x-3) = 0 -> x = -½ or x = 3. Since sinθ ∈ [-1,1], sinθ = -½ -> θ = 7pi/6, 11pi/6 Practice (10 min): Students attempt the practice questions independently; circulate and support. Plenary (5 min): Review answers and address misconceptions.
